useCase.name: Review a submitted inquiry and forward it to the Principal

intent.name: inquiry.review
intent.summary: Record the School Admin's review of a submitted inquiry and move it — forwarded to the Principal, returned to Staff, or held for the family to be contacted. One step.
routesHere: forward the Ahmed Raza inquiry to the principal

routesHere.text: ye inquiry principal ko bhej do
routesHere.gloss: forward this inquiry to the principal

routesHere.text: is inquiry ko wapas bhejo, guardian relationship missing hai
routesHere.gloss: send this inquiry back, the guardian relationship is missing

routesHere: return this one — the date of birth doesn't match the class

routesHere.text: family se poochna hai, inquiry rok lo
routesHere.gloss: we need to ask the family, hold the inquiry

routesHere: review this inquiry and put it up to the principal

request.text: is inquiry ko approve kar do

routesElsewhere.note: Review decides only whether the Principal should be asked; it decides no admission (BR-9). Approving is the Principal's act.
Returning an inquiry never closes it — a family waiting on the school is not a closed inquiry (BR-6).

request.text: family ko call karke bata do kya kya chahiye
request.gloss: call the family and tell them what is needed

routesElsewhere.goesTo: inquiry.review with outcome Contact family, then inquiry.message — UC-02-12
routesElsewhere.note: Recording that the family must be contacted and actually contacting them are two acts. The first is here; the second is a message.

routesElsewhere.request: correct the guardian's phone number on this inquiry
routesElsewhere.goesTo: A correction on the inquiry, recorded with its previous value (BR-5).
routesElsewhere.note: UC-02-02 allows the reviewer to correct obvious errors, but no capability for it is specified here. See the open question.

routesElsewhere.request: check whether this child is already a student
routesElsewhere.note: The duplicate check runs server-side during review (BR-3) and comes back on the response. It is not a separate call.

steps.note: One step. The duplicate check against current students, former students and other open inquiries runs inside it (BR-3) and comes back on the response — the plan does not call for it separately.

plan.onFailure: Stop and report. Completeness, the reviewer's role, and whether the inquiry has already been forwarded are all enforced by the API and arrive as errors; the plan does not test for them beforehand.
plan.atomicity: One write. The review record, the status change, the reviewer and the audit entry are written together or not at all. The review is recorded even where nothing changed (BR-1), so a run that reports no movement has still left a trace of the check. Nothing is sent to the family.

operations.name: inquiry.review
operations.idempotencyKey: inquiry_id + outcome, so a repeated call returns ALREADY_FORWARDED rather than recording a second review
operations.purpose: Record a School Admin's review and move the inquiry — forward, return, or hold for contact — with the duplicate check run as part of it.

parameters.name: inquiry_id

resolves.onNoMatch: Refuse. No inquiry matches in this branch.
resolves.onAmbiguous: Ask, naming the candidates with child name, guardian and status.

parameters.notes: The inquiry, resolved from how the actor named it — a reference, the child's name, or the guardian's number.

parameters.name: outcome
parameters.type: enum: Forward to Principal | Return to Staff | Contact family
parameters.notes: What the admin decided. Forwarding is a recommendation, not a decision (BR-9).

parameters.name: missing_items
parameters.notes: Maximum 500 characters. Required for Return to Staff and Contact family (BR-4, E2): 'incomplete' with no detail sends the inquiry round in a circle. Omit for a forward.

parameters.name: review_note
parameters.notes: Maximum 500 characters. Anything the Principal should know before deciding. Never shown to the family.

parameters.name: branch_id
parameters.notes: Never from the request, even where the request names a campus or a past year (branch-scope, academic-session-scope).

returns.description: The inquiry as it now stands, and what the duplicate check found.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Under review, Returned for information, or Forwarded to Principal.

fields.name: duplicate_matches
fields.description: Any current student, former student or other open inquiry matching this child (BR-3). Empty is a result, not an absence of one.

fields.name: duplicate_check_ran
fields.description: False where the check could not run, in which case the inquiry is marked unverified (E5).

fields.name: readmission_match_confirmed
fields.description: For a re-admission, whether the previous student ID has been confirmed. Forwarding without it is refused (BR-7).

errors.meaning: A required field on the inquiry is still empty, so it cannot be forwarded.
errors.note: The message names the field. An incomplete inquiry reaching the Principal wastes the one decision that matters (BR-2). Never re-emit with the outcome changed to get past it.

errors.meaning: Return or Contact was chosen with no missing items named.
errors.note: Message: "Name what is missing. The person receiving this needs to know what to do."

errors.meaning: The inquiry has already been forwarded to the Principal.
errors.note: The message names the date. Not a failure to retry.

errors.meaning: A Staff user attempted to forward.
errors.note: Only a School Admin may forward. In practice the capability is absent from a Staff allow-list and never planned with.

errors.meaning: The duplicate check could not run.
errors.written: The review is recorded and the inquiry is marked unverified.
errors.note: Not a failure of the review. Report that the inquiry is marked unverified rather than that the review failed.

errors.meaning: The inquiry was closed as declined since it was listed.
errors.note: Re-opening is inquiry.reopen and a separate decision, never chained onto this.

planningRules.rule: Never name the missing items yourself. Return to Staff and Contact family both refuse without them (E2), and a list a planner composed describes what it thinks is absent rather than what the reviewer decided is absent.

Never change the outcome to get past a refusal. A forward refused for an incomplete field is not a return; it is an incomplete inquiry, and forwarding it as something else moves it while leaving the gap.
Never re-emit the review after ALREADY_FORWARDED. A second review is not recorded and the inquiry has moved on; the answer is where it is now.

Never treat an empty duplicate_matches as the same thing as duplicate_check_ran false. The first says the child is not on file; the second says nobody looked. Reporting the second as the first is how a duplicate enrolment gets created (BR-3).
Never chain an approval onto a forward. Review decides only whether the Principal should be asked (BR-9), and the Principal's decision is a separate capability with a separate allow-list entry.
Carry the actor's own words into review_note and missing_items. The Principal and the Staff member read them, and a planner's paraphrase loses what the reviewer actually noticed.

reversal.statement: There is no un-review. A review is a record of a check that happened, and it is recorded even when nothing changed (BR-1). A forward made in error is answered by the Principal's decision, or by the inquiry being returned afterwards — both further recorded acts, never a compensating call.

request.text: Ahmed Raza wali inquiry principal ko bhej do, sab theek hai
request.gloss: forward the Ahmed Raza inquiry to the principal, everything is in order

resolvedPlans.context: School Admin, Johar Town branch. The inquiry is at Pending review.

steps.note: missing_items is omitted, because it is required only for a return or a contact (BR-4). The duplicate check runs inside the call.

resolvedPlans.outcome: The inquiry moves to Forwarded to Principal with the reviewer and date recorded, and duplicate_matches comes back empty — meaning the check ran and found nothing, which is not the same as no check (PR-4).

request.text: is inquiry ko wapas bhej do — guardian ka relationship nahi likha aur date of birth galat lag rahi hai
request.gloss: send this inquiry back — the guardian relationship is not filled in and the date of birth looks wrong

inputs.missing_items: Guardian relationship not filled in; date of birth looks wrong.

steps.note: The missing items are the reviewer's own words, carried across. The plan does not compose a tidier list (PR-1, PR-6).

resolvedPlans.outcome: The inquiry returns to Staff at Returned for information and stays in the queue — returning never closes it (BR-6). The Staff member reads exactly what the reviewer wrote.

resolvedPlans.request: forward the Sana Malik re-admission to the principal
resolvedPlans.context: School Admin, Johar Town branch, on an inquiry marked Re-admission whose previous student ID has not been confirmed.

steps.note: The plan is emitted unchanged; it does not test for the unconfirmed match beforehand. The API refuses it under BR-7.

resolvedPlans.outcome: Nothing is written. Report that the previous student ID must be confirmed first, which is readmission.match.confirm (UC-02-09) — a separate plan and a separate decision.
